name: manual_005a2d
claim: After a peer stack restart, verify the peer TLS port is actually listening before treating service health endpoints as proof of the front end; retry the documented lane and report the exact error when it still fails.

decisions.notes: The Mac outage file showed 8443 dead after a plain restart while 8000/8001/8002 answered; the Windows retry confirmed the TLS portal lane delivered after the Caddy restart.

rationale: The Mac outage file showed 8443 dead after a plain restart while 8000/8001/8002 answered; the Windows retry confirmed the TLS portal lane delivered after the Caddy restart.
